candidate.change: Count output batches and rows under cfg(test), and measure allocator activity around the same bounded runtime.

execution.measurement: allocation_counter::measure around execute_band only; fixtures and runtime construction are outside the measured closure
execution.resource_guard_policy: Observe the first allocation result before choosing a peak-memory assertion; do not relax a failed bound.
execution.additional_observations: The complete Join regression may contribute a second allocator observation; it is retained rather than selected as a favorable repetition.

cases.connection: A duplicate-heavy right side can produce many matches. The cap must stop output collection after the first oversized DataFusion output batch rather than materialize all matches.

unmeasured: No latency or throughput comparison, RSS attribution, general Join performance verdict, multi-batch hot-path input, durable hot-path restore, or ASOF acceptance.
